parties.respondent: STATE OF TAMIL NADU AND OTHERS ETC.

summary: Forest conservation vs displaced tea estate workers' rehabilitation; reserved forest declaration under Wildlife Act, 1972; core critical tiger habitat notification; forest restoration imperative for ecological balance; traditional forest dwellers' definition; anthropocentric to ecocentric approach shift; encroachment removal mandatory; rehabilitation of non-traditional workers not overriding forest conservation.
final_judgment: Continuing mandamus initiated; High Court directed to address forest restoration; rehabilitation claims to be examined separately for traditional forest dwellers.
